level2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Transparent watercolor game VFX sprite sheet of an elongated light droplet single shot flying RIGHT. Five input images are the five ordered animation stages of LEVEL 1: Image1 formation orb, Image2 stretching, Image3 flight, Image4 compact impact, Image5 fading flecks. Produce ONE sprite sheet in an EXACT THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW equal cell grid, landscape 2:1 total canvas. Top row stage1,stage2,stage3; bottom row stage4,stage5,EMPTY. Each cell 4:3 ratio. All visible artwork strictly inside each cell with generous clear margin, no borders, no labels. GENUINE transparent background including margins and empty cell. The effect is warm honey-gold and ivory watercolor light with rice paper granulation INSIDE the paint only. Rounded leading head on right and wispy tapered tail on left. No literal arrow, no triangular arrowhead, shaft or feathers, no solid facets. Stage1 compact formation glow centered in cell, stage2 short droplet centered, stage3 long droplet centered, stage4 small airy light impact around x72% y50% of its own cell with slight residual leftward tail, stage5 dim loose fading specks at same hit location. Create LEVEL 2: moderately stronger than reference, 15 percent broader/brighter droplet, stronger ivory core, slightly longer fine tail, a handful of small trailing sparks, slightly fuller compact hit burst and 5 fading flecks. Still restrained soft glow.
